description: Look up IANA service name and transport protocol port assignments. Pass exactly one of `port` (a number, 0–65535), `service` (an exact service name such as "postgresql"), or `keyword` (words matched against service names and descriptions). Results list every transport (tcp, udp, sctp, dccp) separately, report the registry range row containing an unassigned port, and classify the port as System (0–1023), User (1024–49151), or Dynamic/Private (49152–65535). Service names registered without a port (DNS-SD names) appear with no port.

keyword.description: Words matched as whole tokens against service names and descriptions, e.g. "network time". Pass exactly one of port, service, or keyword.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, 1–100. Default 25.

offset.description: Number of keyword matches to skip; pass the next_offset of the previous response to get the next page. Default 0.

port.description: Port number, 0–65535 (a digit string such as "443" also works). Returns every row for that port plus the range row containing it. Pass exactly one of port, service, or keyword.

service.description: Exact service name, case-insensitive, up to 15 characters, e.g. "postgresql" or "whois++". Pass exactly one of port, service, or keyword.

transport.description: Keep only rows for this transport protocol. Rows without a transport (most range rows and every service name without a port) are always kept. Applies to every mode.

name: iana_lookup_port

assignments.description: Matching rows. Port mode: exact rows, then range rows containing the port. Other modes: ascending by port, port-less rows last.

port.description: Port number of a single-port row.

port_range.description: Range of a range row, e.g. "1002-1007".

id.description: E.g. "RFC 9110", a draft name, a registry id, or a URL.

label.description: Label text, when it adds to id and section.

service_name.description: Registered service name; absent on range and unnamed rows.

state.description: assigned (service name present), reserved or unassigned (the description is that word), else unnamed (e.g. "De-registered").

transport.description: tcp, udp, sctp, or dccp; usually absent on range rows.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `mode_required`: None, or more than one, of port, service, and keyword was given. `upstream_unreadable`: The port registry file could not be fetched, was larger than this server accepts, or parsed to zero records. `pacer_shed`: This server's own iana.org request queue is too full for the call to start in time. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: True when a returned row has a registered service name.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; absent on the last.

notice.description: Guidance on a miss, a cut list, or another condition.

port_class.description: Port mode: the requested port's class.

source.description: Provenance and freshness of the answer.

fetched_at.description: ISO 8601 time of the last successful fetch or revalidation.

registry_id.description: Id of the registry file that answered.

registry_updated.description: The registry's own last-updated date; absent for the protocol index.

stale.description: True when a refresh failed and a cached copy up to 7 days old answered.

totalCount.description: Matches before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist than were returned.

title: Look up a port assignment
